rationale: In the early campaign, the incumbent-to-GP-maximum gap is 0.12, median uncertainty is 1.23, 68 scaffolds have been observed, the last batch mean was 7.19. This supports a mixed batch with an exploration majority while preserving the available hedge channels.
expected_outcome: The batch will have a mean affinity of at least 6.4 and add at least 3 new scaffolds.
